method: Fetched https://alaskanews.com/news-sitemap.xml (articles published in the last 48 hours), then fetched each article's public HTML page and read the provenance line printed under the article body. No editor review is on record for this article.'; D no AI label. The visible byline was recorded for 21 of 90 rows only (null where it was not captured), so this file supports claims about the labels and not about bylines.
